result_class: Total-Text TRAIN-holdout NeuSpell correction diagnostic; not Table 5
parameter_selection: Fixed engineering hypotheses before running this pretrained head on Total-Text; TRAIN-holdout development, no TEST loaded. Prior MLM experiments motivate a trained spelling head; no native PARSeq confidence-protection gate.

scientific_choices.rationale: User-requested BERT extension inspired by NeuSpell (EMNLP Demos 2020). This English spelling-trained head is frozen; natural/synthetic spelling errors differ from scene OCR.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: May handle error patterns better than generic MLM; proper names and non-English labels may be replaced.

scientific_choices.rationale: Pinned author snippet averages noisy-word BERT subword states before its genuine 100002-class word head. Preserve source idx2token order and special IDs; authenticate Git blobs and HF LFS weight metadata. No downloaded Python is executed.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Faithful decoding of the pretrained spelling head, with local fast-offset target extraction checked separately.

scientific_choices.rationale: Same latest completed letterbox single-head word_f1_control, masks->external contours->PARSeq, TRAIN-holdout125, originalRGB crops, native256, padding0/no area or top10 filters, SHA-bound cached outputs.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Preserves localization ceiling and paired crop identities across all arms.

scientific_choices.rationale: Eligible ASCII single words >=3; protect numbers/punctuation/mixed-case names/multiword crops. Original OCR word remains visible. Raw-head control plus fixed conservative edit/probability/KEEP gates; sum casefold label probabilities for in-vocabulary KEEP, but never replace an OOV string's unscoreable probability by UNK. Optional caption prefix budget80 words; over256 input tokens or unknown target causes explicit KEEP.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Prevents unbounded conservative rewrites; restrictions and word-head vocabulary limit recoverability. Probabilities are not calibrated correctness estimates.

scientific_choices.rationale: Micro exact Unicode casefold retained-punctuation bboxIoU>=0.5 deterministic one-to-one matching, all983 care GT denominator, recovered/damaged/changed and unchanged geometry. Not the official polygon protocol.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Paired TRAIN diagnostic only; no Table5 or TEST transfer claim.

scientific_choices.rationale: Cached upstream outputs and isolated CPU or CUDA:0 FP32 word-head inference; batch8, max256 tokens, four CPU threads, deterministic seeds/settings. No co-resident mask/PARSeq/caption models.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Records correction-only timing/shapes and allocated/reserved GPU peaks; not paper end-to-end execution.

scientific_choices.rationale: Real pretrained assets not yet available in the sandbox. NeuSpell benefit, conservative thresholds, caption conditioning and GPU memory require actual execution; optional captions must cover the same SHA-bound Total-Text images.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: No improvement, calibrated threshold, caption benefit or strict reproduction claim is supported before measurement.
